pitch_new_folder_trigger.description: Runs for each new folder in Pitch. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields folder_id, parent_id, name, owner.id, owner.name, created_at, updated_at

pitch_new_teamspace_trigger.description: Runs for each new teamspace in Pitch. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields teamspace_id, workspace_id, name, description, join_policy, members_can_invite, avatar.type, avatar.icon, avatar.color, created_at, updated_at

pitch_new_template_trigger.description: Runs for each new template in Pitch. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields template_id, name, created_at, updated_at, source
